app.name: Engapp
app.tagline: English words, a little every day

sync.label: Sync status
sync.offline: Offline — your data is safe on this device

home.title: Today
home.stripSummary: You reviewed on {{active}} of the last {{total}} days.
home.emptyBody: Your word list is empty. Add your first word; the app builds the review schedule.
home.emptyStep1: Add an English word or phrase with its Turkish meaning and an example sentence.
home.emptyStep2: Review a few minutes a day; cards return just before you would forget them.
home.emptyStep3: Track your streak here; every day you review extends it.

review.title: Review
review.tapToFlip: Tap the card to flip it
review.noVoice: No speech: this device has no English voice
review.suspendedBody: You can resume it from the Cards screen.
review.cardGone: This card was deleted or suspended; moved to the next one.
review.editSentenceHint: An English sentence containing the term. The fill-the-gap card is built from it.
review.noCardsBody: There is nothing to review. Start by adding your first word.

summary.title: Session complete
summary.streakExtended: Today was added to your streak.

library.title: Cards
library.emptyHint: Add your first word; the review schedule sets itself up.
library.noMatchHint: Shorten the search or clear the filters.
library.deleteBody: Its meanings and cards are deleted. Review history is kept; adding the word again brings it back.

filter.title: Filter and sort
filter.dupHint: Notes that arrived with the same term in an account merge.

detail.duplicateHint: Possible duplicate: a note with the same term came from another device. Delete one or keep both.
detail.suspendHint: Suspended cards are not reviewed; their history is kept.
detail.deleteSenseBody: Its production and cloze cards are deleted. Review history is kept.
detail.duplicateTerm: Another note already has this term.

stats.title: Stats
stats.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move between days. Home and End go to the start and end of the week.
stats.currentStreakPending: Review today to keep the streak.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.

account.guestHint: Your data lives only on this device. With an account it syncs across your devices.
account.signIn: Sign in or create an account

sync.offHint: In guest mode changes stay on this device.

study.dailyNewHint: Every new card brings a few more reviews over the next days. 10 a day is sustainable for most people.
study.retentionExplain: When a card comes up, you will remember it about {{pct}}% of the time.
study.retentionLow: Fewer reviews, but you forget more.
study.retentionMid: A good balance for most people.
study.retentionHigh: You forget less, but reviews increase noticeably.
study.dayStartHint: Reviews before this hour count for the previous day, so late nights do not break your streak.
study.levelHint: AI skips very basic words below this level.

appearance.hint: “System” follows your device's light or dark setting.

voice.hint: Words are read with this voice, from your device's speech engine.
voice.missing: This device has no voice for that accent; the default English voice is used.
voice.unsupported: This browser does not support speech.

data.description: Your data is on this device. Back up regularly and keep the file somewhere else.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.heading: Take your words with you
auth.lead: With an account your reviews sync across devices and you can pull cards out of texts with AI.
auth.guestNote: In guest mode everything works on this device. You can sign in any time.
auth.privacy: We only use your name, email address and profile photo from your Google account.
auth.unavailableTitle: Sign-in is off in this version
auth.unavailableBody: No account server is configured. As a guest, reviews, adding cards and stats work fully on this device; sync and AI card extraction need an account.
auth.failedBody: Something went wrong on the way back from Google: {{message}}
auth.startFailed: Couldn't start Google sign-in. Check your connection and try again.
auth.signOutBody: Your data stays on this device. Sync stops while you're signed out and picks up where it left off when you sign in with the same account.
auth.signedOutLocalHint: Your data is on this device. Sign in again to sync.
auth.guestHint: Your data lives only on this device. Sign in to sync across devices and pull cards out of texts with AI.

placeholder.body: This screen is still being built.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for has moved or never existed.

dev.title: UI gallery
dev.intro: Every component, in both themes. For visual QA.
dev.dialogBody: This card and its review history will be removed from this device and your account.
dev.toastBody: It will show up in tomorrow's first review.
dev.splitTitle: Light and dark themes side by side

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Add with Enter or a comma.

sentence.notFound: The term was not found in this sentence, so no cloze card will be made. Make sure the sentence contains it.

add.pageHint: A new word or phrase, its meaning and, if you like, an example sentence.
add.termHint: Use the dictionary form: “give up”, not “gave up”.
add.exists: This word already exists; add a new meaning
add.sentenceHint: A sentence that uses the term; it also creates a cloze card.
add.moreDetails: English gloss and part of speech
add.glossHint: Tells meanings apart: “the land beside a river”.
add.cardsHint: Each meaning gets a production card, and a cloze card when it has a sentence.
add.cardsCreated: {{count}} card(s) created; they show up in tomorrow's review.
add.nothingNew: This meaning of “{{term}}” is already saved
add.invalid: Term and meaning cannot be empty.
add.failed: The card could not be saved. Try again.

ai.hint: Look up this word's meanings in the shared dictionary.

import.privacy: Do not upload confidential work documents.
import.privacyWhy: Text is processed on the free AI tier; Google may read it.
import.soonBody: Coming here soon. For now, add words in the “Manual” tab.

backup.title: JSON backup
backup.doneHint: Save the file to a cloud folder or your email.
backup.reminderNever: You have not backed up yet.
backup.reminderBody: In guest mode your data is only on this device.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.mergeHint: Records from the backup are added; where both sides have a record, the newest wins. Nothing on this device is deleted.
restore.overwriteHint: Notes and cards on this device go back to the backup; anything not in it is deleted. Review history is always kept.
restore.failed: Restore failed. Your data was not changed.

errors.invalid_json: The file could not be read; it is not a JSON backup.
errors.invalid_format: This is not an Engapp backup, or it is incomplete.
errors.unsupported_version: This backup comes from a newer version. Update the app first.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The backup file is damaged or was edited (checksum mismatch).

csv.title: Export CSV
csv.hint: Opens in Excel: word, meaning, IPA, sentence, tags.

storage.onHint: The browser will not delete your data to free up space.
storage.offHint: The browser may delete data to free up space; your data is also in your account.
storage.deniedGuest: Create an account or back up; the browser may delete data to free up space.
storage.deniedHelp: Installing the app to your home screen or desktop usually grants it.
storage.unsupported: This browser does not support persistent storage.
storage.unknown: This browser does not report storage use.

install.title: Install the app
install.hint: Opens from your home screen, runs full screen and works offline.
install.manual: Use “Install app” or “Add to home screen” in your browser menu.
install.installed: Engapp runs as an app on this device.

ios.title: Add to your iPhone home screen
ios.why: Safari may delete data of sites that are not on the home screen. Added, Engapp opens like an app and your data is kept.
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom bar.
ios.step2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
ios.step3: Tap “Add” at the top right; Engapp is on your home screen.

integrity.title: Data integrity
integrity.hint: Checks that cards, notes and review records are consistent.
integrity.problemsHint: Some records are inconsistent. Repair recomputes card states from the review history; review records are never deleted.
integrity.repairFailed: Repair failed. Download the error log and send it to us.

pwa.reloadAlt: Reload the page to open the new version

account.chooseBody: How should we bring the cards on this device together with the ones in your account?
account.chooseBodyOther: This device holds another account's cards. How should we combine them with the account you signed in with?
account.mergeHint: Recommended. Cards and review history from both sides are kept. A word that appears twice is marked “possible duplicate”; nothing is deleted.
account.discardLocalHint: Cards and history on this device are deleted and your account's are downloaded.
account.discardAccountHint: Cards in your account are deleted and this device's are uploaded to it.
account.irreversible: This can't be undone. If you're not sure, make a backup first or choose “Merge”.
account.errorBody: Check your connection and try again, or continue as a guest for now. Your data is safe on this device.
account.doneDuplicates: {{count}} words were marked “possible duplicate”; you can review them in Cards.

syncPanel.localHint: In guest mode changes are kept only on this device.
syncPanel.signedOutHint: Signed out; changes collect on this device and are sent when you sign in.
syncPanel.stuck_one: {{count}} change failed to send 10 times. Details are in the error log; make a backup if this continues.
syncPanel.stuck_other: {{count}} changes failed to send 10 times. Details are in the error log; make a backup if this continues.
syncPanel.offline: You're offline. Sync will run on its own when you're back online.
syncPanel.failed: Sync failed. It will retry shortly.
syncPanel.busy: Another tab is syncing right now.
syncPanel.authFailed: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
syncPanel.localIndicatorFull: Guest mode — your data is safe on this device. Sign in to sync.
syncPanel.unavailableIndicatorFull: Your data is safe on this device.

importer.privacyWhy: On the free AI tier, Google may read submitted text and use it to improve its models.
importer.signInTitle: Sign in to pull cards out with AI
importer.signInBody: Word and phrase suggestions come from AI on the server, so you need to sign in with Google. Adding cards by hand works as a guest too.
importer.unavailableTitle: AI is off in this version
importer.unavailableBody: No AI server is configured. You can add cards from the “Manual” tab.
importer.level: Your level: {{level}} — very basic words below it aren't suggested.

paste.label: English text
paste.placeholder: Paste an article, email or book chapter…
paste.statsEmpty: Paste whole sentences; long texts are split into parts.
paste.tooShort: Paste at least one full sentence.
paste.tooLong: The text is too long (at most {{max}} characters). Split it and upload the parts separately.

pdf.hint: Up to {{mb}} MB. Only PDFs that contain text; scanned pages can't be read.
pdf.noText: This PDF has no readable text
pdf.noTextBody: Scanned (image) PDFs aren't supported yet. If you can copy the text, use the “Paste text” tab.
pdf.tooBig: The file is too large (at most {{mb}} MB).
pdf.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected and couldn't be opened.
pdf.failed: Couldn't read the PDF. The file may be damaged.

job.title: Import
job.queuedOffline: Queued — starts on its own when you're back online
job.cacheHits_one: {{count}} part came from the cache; no AI call.
job.cacheHits_other: {{count}} parts came from the cache; no AI calls.
job.readyEmpty: No new words to suggest in this text.

errors.daily_limit: You've reached today's AI limit. You can continue tomorrow where you left off; processed parts aren't lost.
errors.quota_exceeded: The AI is very busy right now. Try again in a few minutes; processed parts aren't lost.
errors.ai_failed: The AI couldn't process this part. Try again.
errors.not_signed_in: You've been signed out. Sign in again and retry.
errors.invalid_input: This text couldn't be processed. Shorten it a little and try again.
errors.bad_response: The server sent an unexpected answer. Try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. The job is queued and starts on its own when you're back online.

preview.title: Preview
preview.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or made on another device.
preview.existsHint: This meaning is already in your cards.
preview.addSenseHint: The word is in your cards; this meaning is new.
preview.lowConfidenceHint: The AI isn't very sure about this candidate ({{pct}}% confidence); check the meaning.
preview.addedBody: {{senses}} meanings, {{cards}} cards. They'll come up for review in turn.
preview.confirmFailed: Couldn't add the cards. Try again.
preview.discardBody: The candidates are deleted; cards you've added aren't affected.
preview.alreadyDoneBody: The candidates you chose were added to your cards.

lookup.offline: You're offline and this word isn't in the dictionary cache; try again when you're back online.
lookup.signIn: Sign in to fill this in with AI.
lookup.noSenses: No meanings found for this word in the dictionary or from AI.
